title: Who Teaches Which Token? Verifier-Gated Multi-Expert On-Policy Distillation for Scientific Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2609.15404v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (OPD) is becoming the standard way to integrate specialist capabilities into one model: train experts with RL, then distill them into the student on its own rollouts. Existing recipes assign supervision at the sequence level - each prompt goes to one domain teacher and every token receives the same weight - which implicitly assumes that a teacher is uniformly useful across a response. We find instead that useful teacher signal is sparse and heterogeneous along a reasoning trajectory, which raises a finer question: who should teach which token? Verifier-Gated Multi-Expert On-Policy Distillation (VG-OPD) answers it by verification: the counterfactual gain of an expert on a specific answer criterion licenses that expert to teach, its disagreement with the student localizes the supervision, and criterion importance sets its weight; the gated KL enters GRPO as an additive token-level advantage. Instantiate

translated_title: 谁教哪个词元？面向科学推理的验证器门控多专家在线策略蒸馏
translated_abstract: 多教师在线策略蒸馏（OPD）正在成为将专家能力整合到单一模型中的标准方法：先用强化学习训练专家，然后在学生模型自身的 rollout 上将其蒸馏到学生模型中。现有方案在序列层面分配监督信号——每个提示只分配给一个领域教师，且每个词元获得相同的权重——这隐含地假设了教师在整条回答上具有同等效用。然而我们发现，有用的教师信号在推理轨迹上是稀疏且异构的，这就引出了一个更精细的问题：谁应该教哪个词元？验证器门控多专家在线策略蒸馏（VG-OPD）通过验证来回答这个问题：专家在特定答案标准上的反事实增益决定该专家是否有资格进行教学，其与学生模型的分歧用于定位监督位置，标准的重要性决定监督权重；门控后的 KL 散度作为附加的词元级优势进入 GRPO。
tldr: 该论文提出 VG-OPD 方法，通过验证器评估专家在特定答案标准上的反事实增益来决定“哪个教师教哪个词元”，并将门控 KL 散度以词元级优势的形式融入 GRPO，实现更精准的多专家在线策略蒸馏以提升科学推理能力。
